constructor.algorithm: Load m4_l8_compatibility_expected_responses_v1.json rows in stored order. For each row emit keys row_ordinal,case_kind,case_id,expected_response_sha256,observed,observed_response_sha256,pass with observed=expected, observed_response_sha256=expected_response_sha256, pass=true. RFC8785 the 13-row array to obtain payload_sha256. Duplicate that exact array for run_ordinal 0 then 1. Load failure_injections from m4_harness_executable_fixtures_v1.json in stored order; emit case_id, mutation_sha256=SHA256(RFC8785(mutation)), expected_code, observed_code=expected_code, pass=true. Assemble report with the fixed header values and key/value definitions in m4_l8_compatibility_report_schema_v1.json; RFC8785 the report and append one LF.
